subject.title: feat(wizard): deliver progress over the RPC wizard protocol

question: Should RPC wizard progress delivery preserve current clients that answer progress steps before this PR can merge, or may OpenClaw intentionally switch to a re-poll-without-answer progress contract now?
rationale: The PR changes client-visible `wizard.next` semantics, and current in-repo consumers conflict with the proposed non-interactive progress contract; repository policy treats gateway protocol changes as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Preserve Existing Clients First
options.body: Require the PR to tolerate answered progress steps or update bundled consumers with focused coverage before emitting progress broadly.

options.title: Accept The New Client Contract
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally require clients to re-poll without answering progress, but that needs explicit rollout acceptance and proof.

options.title: Pause Behind The Umbrella
options.body: Pause this branch until the broader wizard RPC parity issue settles progress, auth challenge, and client-rendering semantics together.

recommendation.title: Preserve Existing Clients First
recommendation.body: Require the PR to tolerate answered progress steps or update bundled consumers with focused coverage before emitting progress broadly.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Crestodian and wizard-related onboarding work makes steipete the strongest routing candidate for the client-visible setup contract decision.
